steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar... Spot can't cover you if you're too far forward.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And you were completely out of position, Catapult.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: That cover was in a lousy spot.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How was I supposed to blast those slugs if I didn't have line-of-sight?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Besides, I wouldn't have gotten jumped if Spot wasn't holed up in the back.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Me? Holed up in the back?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Open your eyes, sister. That was simulated Originium artillery.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You and Midnight would've been dust if I didn't have my shield up there.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Not that things turned out much different, in the end.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: While the result was less than elegant, my magnificent swordplay brought low at least three foes before I fell.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I think there was plenty of entertainment to be had.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'm sorry... I didn't see the one behind...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I just wanted to cut through that bad guy for Miss Orchid...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's not about how many enemies you took out.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's about teamwork.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We are Reserve Op Team A6.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We are a—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: A motley crew of misfits.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I heard that, Catapult.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Never mind. Let's call it a day. Dismissed.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Why the long face, Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why do you think?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot, Catapult, Midnight. All good people, but why can't they get along when you put them together?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Beats me. They're hardly the weirdest, by Rhodes Island standards. People generally like them.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Maybe some people just don't mix well.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Weren't the reserve op teams supposed to be experimental anyway? You could always apply for a transfer to Logistics Department.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Mutters) But I only volunteered for the front lines because I got tired of sitting in an office pushing papers.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: What was that?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're right. When I was named captain of A6, HR told me not to feel pressure about it.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Then why do you—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Rhodes Island must have put me in charge so I can help them figure out what a team is.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Individuality is all well and good, but it must be established on the basis of mutual respect. It's not ability they're missing; it's respect for each other.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right now, A6 isn't a team; it's just a pile of strangers tossed into the same room.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Wait a second, Orchid. There are so many bright minds on Rhodes Island; surely you don't have to be the one who has to worry about it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's normal for me to worry, isn't it?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I just feel like they should get to know each other, because we talk about stuff like teamwork. Not as operators, but simply knowing each other as people.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If they can establish basic social relationships, sit down and talk to each other calmly...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: You've always been soft-hearted.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let me try again.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Are you sure? You might be disappointed again.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm not sure I can drink this hot cocoa in peace, if I don't at least try.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's the last card, Catapult!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No peeking at Spot's cards!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It's called tactical recon!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You have the Joker in your hand, don't you, Spot?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I can tell, the way your face froze!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That's my poker face, you idiot. Besides... I win.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Straight.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey! You must've cheated! How did you get so lucky?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I guess fate isn't smiling on Catapult today either.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: A magnificent play by Spot, though.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Even I got fooled.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot's so good!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Just lucky.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Next round?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No rush. I prepared some snacks.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Mm... you really do know how to make a cup of tea, Orchid. I don't think I've had a cup this good in months.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Thanks, Midnight. By the way, these magazines are for you. I think you'll find the styles you're looking for in them.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Oh, you're too kind.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Hey, these cookies aren't bad.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Better than the ones I buy, at any rate.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll get more next time. You should eat more, Spot. I don't see you outside often lately.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Tea parties are kind of a bother, but I don't mind free food and drink.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: They're great! You're awesome, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Glad to see you guys looking relaxed.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We really should be able to get along with one another, shouldn't we?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If we can enjoy afternoon tea together...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm sure we can learn to trust each other on the battlefield.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think... we can try to get to know each other better.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Not as operators, but as friends.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Maybe we can talk about our interests, for example?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Captain, I'll be frank with you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I think you're a decent person. You bought us stuff, helped us write our reports, even put together a nice tea party.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But there's a one thing that's been bugging me—why do we have to look like a team?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: We're a team only because Rhodes Island happened to put us together. Sometimes a bad fit is a bad fit.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You know I'm usually on your side, Orchid.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: But I have to agree with Catapult, even if her words are a little blunt.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: There's no need to force things. We could be cordial colleagues, friends even. But there's no need for us to act the part of family.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's not necessary, for you and for us.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: All I can say is don't be too hard on yourself, captain.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Why did everyone go away, Miss Orchid?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Was Popukar a bad girl?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're a good girl, Popukar.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: It's a bunch of grown men and women who are bad...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We screwed up.
I like summer.
The summer outfits column was one of my favorite jobs when I was still a fashion editor.
I'm not an outdoorsy or social woman, but I loved the feeling of vitality that models wearing those outfits gave off.
It's proof that someone is living a life.
And it helps me want to live mine.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How did it come to this? Maybe I should put in a transfer request with HR tomorrow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, screw it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm hurting all over, and the a/c's useless. How am I supposed to get any sleep like this?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Painkillers, painkillers...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Ugh, I'm out.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Guess I need to go to the clinic.
I hate summer.
I hate that heat that engulfs my body.
And I hate how I ache when a humid breeze blows past.
The pain is almost unbearable on those wet, humid nights.
I didn't have to pass by the deck on my way to the clinic.
But I came anyway.
I wasn't sure why. Maybe it was because my body knew it wasn't painkillers that I really wanted.
There's someone on the deck, holding a bottle in his hand.
He's not wearing his signature smile, only calmness with a hint of melancholy.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...Orchid?
He tries to hide the bottle, but there is nowhere on the deck to hide it. He ends up abashedly stashing it behind his back.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I-I was just catching some fresh air—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Are you hurting?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Then stay put.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm not here to scold you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Pour me one.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Do you drink too?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm not proud of it, but I do.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I hate the feeling of being drunk.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Hah, I had customers like that.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: No fans of the nightlife scene, but they were forced to come by their bosses or friends.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: How did you deal with them?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Get them drunk so that they'd pay you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: People who are actually drunk didn't pay all that much.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The ones who actually loosened their purse strings were the types who kept themselves bottled up, until they decideed to pour out a little bit of their true selves to a stranger under the influence.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Are you saying I'm your favorite kind of customer?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: They were my friends. Best friends.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Honeyed words.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Spot can testify. I showed him some photos of me with my friends.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Am I right, Spot?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Spot?!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Just so it's clear, I was here first, then Midnight showed up second. Now you make three.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Does Oripathy give everyone a desire for fresh air at night?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Reading comics in a place like this... you'll ruin your eyes.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: My vision is excellent, thank you very much.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: But frankly, I like you more right now than I usually like you, Captain.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's a brand new compliment...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you get together here often?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Sometimes. Spot's not exactly my type.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Total coincidence, alright? Plenty of people show up here at night, but we happen to be the only ones today—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Miss Orchid! You're really here!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult! Popukar! What are you two—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I couldn't sleep because my eye was hurting. I was looking for you but I didn't know where you were.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So I asked Catapult, and she found you, just like that?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) Uh, it's not like that, Captain.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) I was gonna take her some place I was familiar with, give her some candy, and put her to bed.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) I had no idea all of you were here.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: (Whisper) Do people really come here so often? I was just making that up!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...Now this is more like it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: What's everyone doing here?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Does your eye still hurt, Popukar?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But I feel better now that you're all here!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What about the rest of you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Come now, this is not a debriefing.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I can tell you, I'm hurting like hell.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I doubt Popukar could have woken me up if I wasn't hurting.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I wouldn't be reading comics if I wasn't hurting.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I already told you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did anyone bring painkillers?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I brought some when I left my room. There should be enough for all of us.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You got any more drinks up your sleeves, Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Spot was actually right when he said people like to get some fresh air on deck.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That's why I've got various drinks stowed up here, just in case.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: 'Just in case.' Is that a synonym for 'everything'?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Everything.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's have a drink, then.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Here? Now?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What? Did you think I was just going to dismiss you?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Or say something that would make me want to jump off this deck, like you did earlier today.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Too tired for that.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I think I like you better when you're tired.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Then you don't know me well enough. This is how I usually am.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I only do all that stuff because I'm your captain. Can you imagine how pissed I was when you didn't respond to it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, I just didn't like it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Alright, sorry.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Nothing. Just that I guess we really didn't know each other well enough.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What would you like to drink, Popukar?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Apple juice! Mr. Midnight!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I want gin!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Brandy! Mr. Midnight!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You've got hands, use them.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Jerk.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I once read in a magazine—

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: True friendship is not about knowing what your friends like. It's about knowing what they don't like.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I have a suggestion.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Why don't we talk about our disinterests?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I'll start. I hate anything that keeps people from smiling. Illness, war, hatred, lies, cheating...

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Wait a minute, the list's getting weird.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Because that's how things are. There are just so many things that can keep someone from smiling.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's true.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Thanks. What about you, Catapult?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, there are plenty of things I hate. A boring life, bad food, tedious missions. Oh, and those knights carrying their swords and shields!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: How did you live for so long with so much hate in your heart?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Because I live to spite the things I hate!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Never mind me. I think you might hate even more things than I do, Spot.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: No way.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Unlike you, my hatred is directed towards very specific things. Cheerful people, arrogant people, smooth-talking people, people with too much energy...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You might as well say that you hate everyone. Besides, you're obviously talking about us!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Let me finish.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You guys are a lot like the people that I hate, but I guess you're the exception that proves the rule.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, we've got a weirdo here.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: You're the last person I want to hear that from.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So Spot hates everyone, except us. Does that sound better?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I think I'm already having second thoughts.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What about you, Popukar?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I... I... I hate...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Getting sleepy? Come, you can rest on my lap.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: No... I wanna... hang out...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think that's enough for tonight.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You're not running away, are you, Captain?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Are you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It would be most dastardly.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I hate Oripathy. I hate not being able to sleep because of the pain.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I hate that I'm forced to accept all of this, when I never asked for it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Is that why you wanted to deal with us in your own way, so that you could feel like everything's normal?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't know. But I assure you that I've given up on being a good captain.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I won't put what happened tonight in my reports.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll still give my orders in the next test, but I'll let you act as you see fit.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: That's good news.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think that's enough drinks for tonight. It's time to go to bed.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: One last toast before we go?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sure, sounds fun.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...You guys weren't like this earlier today.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: It's a worthy night for a toast, isn't it?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: To what, though?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: To all of us hurting like hell right now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, come on, really?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But you know what? I like it.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Not bad.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: It hurts like hell. But it feels better when you know there are people hurting together with you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You know, Orchid... all those friends of mine who keep themselves bottled up, until they decide to pour out a little bit of their true selves to a stranger under the influence... they all had one thing in common.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: They all thought their pain was unique, until they poured it out.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Did you really think I wouldn't get angry?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You wouldn't, because you know exactly what I'm talking about.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...It's hardly a positive thing to know that one's pain is not unique. And sharing one's pain is just that, nothing more. Bottling up isn't so bad.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Try something simpler the next time you're trying to comfort someone.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: We just happened to gather here tonight because of a common reason. It doesn't mean anything.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But I wouldn't have had this drink, if not for this coincidence.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You have good taste in wine.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Heavies, 12 o'clock! Get on it, Spot!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: I was already on my way!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Quit posing, Midnight! Are you trying to get me killed?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Patience, patience, I'm looking for an elegant angle.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You're blocking the light, Spot.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Enough talk! Cut inside from the left flank! Stop the two light units!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Aye-aye, Orchid-sama.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Catapult! There's a sniper behind the bunker!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Blow him to smithereens! Don't worry about the bunker!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Out of the way if you don't want to be well-done!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Catapult! You almost took out my hair with that grenade!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Well, your hair's still there, isn't it? Quit complaining!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's more like it. Popukar! Help Spot push that big guy away!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I won't let you hurt Mr. Spot!

steps.name: Team A6
steps.text: (Together) Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I know! Don't rush me!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Tactical flag—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Got it!

a.text: Congratulations, Reserve Op Team A6. <color=#00ff00>You passed the test</color>.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I'm exhausted—!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: C-? Hard work really doesn't pay, does it?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Look happier. At least you're alive.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The score was not very elegant, but I did strike the perfect pose with my last move, didn't I?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Everyone was so cool!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You guys...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heh, I thought Spot was gonna phone it in for sure.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: As for me, I always thought Orchid made a perfect captain. At least she helps me think up excuses for my reports.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Brown-noser. I thought YOU were going to phone it in.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Besides, I never said Orchid wasn't a good captain. She helped me look for a comic the other day.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: As for me, I've always felt that Orchid was my goddess of victory.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Spot.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Yeah, on three. Three, two, one.

steps.name: Catapult & Spot
steps.text: Disgusting slug!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You came too?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I was worried about you.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: But it looks like A6 is in much better shape now. Did that method you were talking about work?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Not even a little bit. It's a long story.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll tell you about it next time. But today...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I know, I know. Go, your team is waiting.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Kill yourself, Midnight.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Today is the day I rid Rhodes Island of this pest.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: You can kill me, but you will never kill my pure heart!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Miss Orchid! What do we do?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Oh, come on...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Put away your chainsaw, Popukar.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm? Oh, okay!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, that's enough.

steps.name: Catapult & Spot & Midnight
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's go. We'll celebrate in the cafeteria.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Today...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...is NOT on me. Everyone pays for their own.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Miser!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm broke, I have to save up for fabric!
